name: Heaven’s Bane
body:
Price 33,500 gp; Aura moderate varied; CL 8th; Weight 8 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This short but heavy staff of ash is capped with a spiked unholy symbol. It can be wielded as a +1 unholy heavy mace, and it also allows use of the following spells:

dread bolt (2) (1 charge)
magic circle against good (3) (1 charge)
vision of hell (3) (1 charge)
unholy blight (4) (2 charges)

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 16,750 gp; Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Craft Staff, dread bolt, magic circle against good, unholy blight, vision of hell; Special creator must be evil
